notes: Read all 499 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; behaviour, state names, API paths, unit handling, i18n keys+defaults, and the page's section structure (header actions -> last-sync line -> summary stats -> monthly spending chart -> sessions table) are preserved. The native file header documents every web->native remap.
L1 `import { useState, useMemo, useCallback }`: kept; the native file also pulls React + useEffect/useRef/ReactNode for the inlined shims and animations.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined useNativeTranslation(): a stable (key, fallback) => fallback shim. This page uses no `{{name}}` interpolation, so every t('key','English') keeps its English default verbatim (i18n intent preserved).

Lint deviation from web: the inner range-filter timestamp variable is `ts` (web `t`) to avoid shadowing the translation function under @typescript-eslint/no-shadow; allEntries is memoised to satisfy react-hooks/exhaustive-deps. Neither changes behaviour.

Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) CSV export (DataTable export + page exportSelectedCsv) uses feature-detected Blob/anchor download, falling back to clipboard, then to an explicit 'Unavailable' state; (b) the invoice <a target=_blank> becomes Linking.openURL; (c) copyLink copies window.location.href when present, else 'Unavailable'; (d) document.title and localStorage (range memory) are feature-detected.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, or Leaflet are imported — only react, react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/Animated/ActivityIndicator/TextInput/Linking/StyleSheet), the ported web-parity charging/vehicles/settings hooks + datePresets lib + DatePresetChips + StatCard, and the existing apps/native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel/theme tokens.
